sections.text: Continued to POOH w/ spear BHA on 5,5in DP from 436 m to 40 m Avgerage tripping speed 800 m/hour
Pulled spear on surface. Inspected and r/b in derrick same
Removed DP slips and installed master bushing
P/u jetting tool and RIH to 20. 6m
Troubleshoot pump control, unable to control mud pumps from rig floor due to PLC issue. Meanwhile carried out TBT for running pump local for jetting wellhead
Washed wellhead w/ 1500 l/min 28 bar 1360 strokes pumped
POOH and l/d jetting tool
P/u and m/u MS-T seal retrieval tool and tested same
RIH to 20. 1m and engaged MS-T seal retrieval tool. Pulled seal free with 110t overpull
POOH from 20m and l/d MS-T seal and retrieval tool
P/u and m/u 10 3/4in cutter BHA
RIH w/ 10 3/4in cutter BHA on 5,5in DP to 127 m cutting depth
Recorded parameters 600 l/min 125 bar, 400 l/min 50 bar, 300 l/min 25 bar, up/down weights 73t/69t
Cut 10 3/4in tieback casing at 127m 400-600 l/min, 35-50 bar, 3-7 KNM
POOH w/ 10 3/4in cutter BHA on 5,5in DP, inspected knives, OK, l/d BHA
P/u spear BHA inspected same
RIH w/ spear BHA and engaged spear in tieback casing. Pulled fish to surface
Performed pre-job meeting to r/u casing tong
Released spear from tieback casing fish. R/b spear in derrick
R/u casing handling equipment
Performed pre-job meeting to pull and l/d 10 3/4in casing
POOH with 10 3/4in tieback casing from 107 m to 0 m
R/d 10 3/4in casing handling equipment
Changed to left hand saver sub on TDS
P/u left hand torque tool with jet sub below M/u torque to 67knm, RIH same on left hand drill pipe from surface to 140m
M/u TDS to string and washed tieback adapter area w/ 1500 l/min 12 bar
Engaged and released tieback adapter w/ 15 KNM
POOH w/ left hand drill pipe from 140m to surface
Removed left hand saver sub
L/d torque tool
P/u and m/u spear BHA
M/u saver sub to TDS
RIH w/ spear to 129m, engage spear to tieback adapter fish
POOH slowly w/ fish on spear to surface
Released spear and l/d tieback adapter fish
R/b spear BHA in the derrick. Meanwhile started step rate testing on f-4 well w/ cement unit
Performed pre-job meeting to handle perforation guns. Meanwhile changed handling gear
P/u and RIH with perforation guns to 12m
P/u wild single, 2x x-overs and firing head, m/u same
RIH w/ perforation BHA to 145m bottom shot depth
